## Summary

What changes and why. Link the spec or plan entry it follows.

## How it was verified

Commands that were actually run, with the result of each (for example `pnpm lint`: pass). For screen work, the widths that were opened in a real browser (390 and 1280) and a screenshot.

## Not verified

What was not run or not looked at, and why.

## Risk and rollback

What can go wrong in production and how to undo it.

## Checklist

- [ ] Each new or changed test failed before the fix
- [ ] Docs updated in the same change
- [ ] Went through `docs/guidelines/pitfalls-and-prevention.md`
- [ ] Only the files of this change are included
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or real customer data
